<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def analyze(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cell_rows=[12,18,24,30,36,42,48]; cell_cols=[11,17,23,29,35,41,47]
    n=[]; gf=[]; gh=[]
    for gr,rt in enumerate(cell_rows):
        for gc,ct in enumerate(cell_cols):
            chars=set()
            for dr in range(4):
                for dc in range(4):
                    chars.add(a[rt+dr][ct+dc])
            if 'N' in chars: n.append((gr,gc))
            if 'G' in chars: gf.append((gr,gc))
            if 'g' in chars: gh.append((gr,gc))
    return n,gf,gh
# select (1,1)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':18}])
n,gf,gh=analyze(current_frame)
print("after select(1,1): N=",n,"Gframe=",gf,"ghost=",gh)
# now ACTION7
action([{'action':'ACTION7'}])
print("ACTION7 result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','score']})
n,gf,gh=analyze(current_frame)
print("after ACTION7: N=",n,"Gframe=",gf,"ghost=",gh)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
